name: Files
description: Which plugin opens which file, recent files, saving, and what happens when a file changes on disk.

desk.files.recent-max.description: How many recent files to remember.

desk.files.fallback.description: The plugin that opens a file no rule names: it reads the format from the first bytes and shows the file's details when it cannot show the file. A name without an extension opens as text first. Empty: such a file does not open.

desk.files.on-change.description: A file changed on disk: reload it when it has no unsaved changes (and ask when it has), always ask, or do nothing.

desk.files.window.description: Where an opener that can show each file in a window of its own (Images, Notes, Data) opens a file: in a window of its own, or in the opener's one window, which then shows them all.

desk.files.history-max-bytes.description: How many bytes the history of earlier versions may hold in all; the oldest versions go first.

desk.files.history-max-versions.description: How many earlier versions of each file the desk keeps; 0 keeps none.
